meta.title: Puntr | Sports predictions with a record that speaks for itself
meta.description: A South African sports prediction community built on transparency. Publish picks before kick-off, get them automatically graded and build a public record you can stand behind. Join free. 18+.
meta.ogDescription: No edited history. No disappearing losses. Just timestamped sports predictions, transparent grading and a public record.

hero.badge: South Africa’s home for accountable sports predictions
hero.tagline: Get in early. Become a founding member. Be part of what's next.
hero.body: Puntr is a sports prediction community for South African fans. Picks open when we launch on Tuesday 1 December 2026, starting with football. Founding Member sign-ups are open now: join free and claim a numbered badge. Every pick will be <1>timestamped and locked</1>, graded automatically and kept in your <1>public record</1> — wins and losses included.

why.title: A track record beats a big claim

stamped.title: Timestamped before kick-off
stamped.body: Every pick must be published before kick-off to count. The timestamp is part of the record.

noEdits.title: No edits, no deletes
noEdits.body: Every settled pick stays visible. No rewriting history when a call goes wrong.

public.title: Public units, ROI and sample size
public.body: Performance is shown with units, ROI and sample size, so there is context behind the numbers.

s1.title: Join free
s1.body: Create your account with your email and a password. You must be 18 or older.

s2.title: Post your picks
s2.body: From launch on 1 December, back your call on upcoming matches before kick-off.

s3.title: Get graded
s3.body: Every pick is <1>locked at kick-off</1> and settled automatically.

s4.title: Climb the weekly leaderboard
s4.body: Build a public record on units, ROI and sample size. Play for pride.

board.title: Weekly leaderboard
board.empty: The weekly leaderboard starts when Puntr launches on 1 December 2026.

join.title: Put your sports knowledge on the record
join.f3: A public record you can share
join.f7: Planned Tipster Support: Punters will be able to recognise verified Tipsters with a consistent track record by sending them PuntPoints. Points, not cash.

platforms.title: Predictions, trends and deep analytical insights across South Africa's most popular bookmakers
platforms.body: Members can record predictions against fixtures and odds offered by the platforms shown. Puntr does not accept bets and is not necessarily affiliated with or endorsed by those platforms.

preview.title: Soweto Derby
preview.locked: On Puntr this pick would be timestamped and locked at kick-off. It could not be edited or deleted.
preview.idle: Picks lock at kick-off and cannot be edited or deleted.
